main_points: Proposed automation system to convert long PDFs into concise, brand-compliant PowerPoint presentations.
Primary goal is to reduce manual presentation work while maintaining strict control over brand assets, fonts, layout, and final PPTX quality.
The system employs a multi-step workflow involving user input, AI processing for summarization and outlining, template-driven content generation, and a PPTX builder for final assembly.
important_facts: System supports large source documents and extracts text from every page.
Output must be editable in PowerPoint and avoid Google Slides due to custom font compatibility issues.
User interface (Next.js) allows PDF upload, project naming, target slide count selection (default 10), and optional tone/audience/brand notes.
AI summarizes content, identifies main storyline, and creates a slide outline, chunking text for large PDFs.
Template library (JSON-based) dictates slide categories, purpose, character limits, usage rules, and image requirements, guiding AI content generation.
Image generation is conditional: a hero image for the first slide, others only for designated template areas; brand assets (logos, icons) are never replaced.
PPTX builder strictly replaces only mapped text and approved image placeholders, preserving original fonts, colors, shapes, logos, and layout.
All project artifacts (logs, extracted text, generated content, images, final PPTX) are stored in Google Drive for review and debugging.

risks_or_missing_context: Accuracy and quality of AI summarization and storyline identification for diverse PDF content.
Effectiveness of AI in selecting appropriate templates and fitting copy within character limits.
Quality and relevance of AI-generated images, especially for complex topics.
Scalability and performance of the system when processing a high volume of large PDFs.
Specifics of the 'approved template library' management and update process.
Error handling and recovery mechanisms if AI processing or content generation fails.
Security measures for handling sensitive PDF content and generated data stored in Google Drive.
